content:
**install spec becomes a package name (#644)**

ADR-0030 Decision 3's mechanical half, built before the rename with an injected name. specVersion puts the v boundary in one place; resolveInstallSpec builds registry and git specs independently rather than formatting one version twice — the registry wants 1.2.0, the git ref wants the tag as written, and neither throws when swapped. installSpecDetail carries source/why so a constant fallback stops looking like a manifest-derived answer; brain-upgrade prints it. MEASURED and it changed the design: compareSemver reads only major.minor.patch, so 1.0.0-rc.1 and 1.0.0 compare EQUAL and a plain sort answers by input order — my first prerelease test passed before the rule existed, for that reason. highestVersion therefore excludes prereleases by rule, with the second reason that check-and-notify must never recommend an rc. A test proves highestTag on registry output returns null, so the two are not interchangeable. Four mutations, M1 and M2 the same defect in opposite directions. Issue #644.
